number_policy: Exact Decimal values with source signs and units. Parenthesized expenses/outflows are signed source presentations; ordinary negative tax benefits are not reversed. Missing is never zero.
period_policy: Select a unique explicitly dated or formally source-year/window identified January-September nonparent column. Undeclared comparative dates remain null; source comparatives are not earlier publications. No annualization or synthetic quarterly subtraction.
source_policy: Selected original report and own next-midnight publication-date proxy. Revised report availability is never backdated; current fetched PDF bytes are not certified unchanged historical snapshots.
verification_policy: Candidates require an independent border-cell/line re-read before export. Representative complete-page assistant review covers layout hazards, not all cohort pages.
